name: Líjar (Spain)
description: Five equal horizontal stripes of green and white, charged at the centre with a white olive tree.
history: The arms and flag of Líjar were approved by decree 29/1994 of 8 February, published in the BOJA on 18 March 1994; the flag is rectangular in the proportion 1:2, divided into five horizontal stripes of equal size, with the silver olive tree of the first quarter of the arms at its centre.
